notes.title: MALYS UPDATE - v0.5 NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[p]Hello exorcists! Welcome to 0.5 of Malys! [/p][p][/p][p]This update is has an assortment of new content, some cleanup, many bugfixes and some prep for v1. The focus has been on trying to solve as many issues as possible before we head into v1, as well as working on all of the content for launch - so while the new content side is limited, rest assured we have been at work and you'll see it in the final game. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.5 - New Content[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]CARD & MECHANIC UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A bunch of new cards have made their way into this build, bringing us close to our final planned total[/p][/*][*][p]Several new curios are in[/p][/*][*][p]Many bugfixes and minor changes to cards and curios across the board[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]NEW ALLIES & RANDOM ENCOUNTERS[/b][/h3][p]We've added three new allies - The Apprentice, The Spirit, and The Imp - and updated The Believer with a new design which we think works significantly better. The Apprentice and The Believer can be found in new random encounters, while The Spirit and The Imp are accessible through exorcisms rewards.[/p][p]On top of that, we've added three new random encounter scenes we've been working on in the background. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]DEMON UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There is a new Lesser Demon in v0.5, Effigy! [/p][/*][*][p]We've added two new Lesser Demon preludes, to help make them less repetitive (and you might even notice that the hosts are now correct in the actual exorcisms)[/p][/*][*][p]Many small adjustments have been made to improve flow of demon behaviours[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.5 - Demon intent, damage and Ward display, Draw & Discard piles[/b][/h2][p]We've updated demon intent display once more, adding numbers to our targeting indicators - you should now know exactly how much damage will be done to an entity, or how much Ward will be added. [/p][p]Damage and Ward numbers should generally be accurate in all displays - if you see a number, it should be correct![/p][p]On the topic of Ward, we've updated how Ward displays entirely, making it clearer when an entity has or does not have Ward. [/p][p]Draw & Discard pile view has finally been added, so you can see what you have available. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.5 - Cinematic Subtitles[/b][/h2][p]We now have the option for subtitles during cinematics! This will hopefully come in handy to any of our deaf and hard-of-hearing players who have been wondering what the hell goes on in our run opening cinematic.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.5 - Bugfixes/General[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]UI/UX & TEXT FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now view Draw and Discard piles[/p][/*][*][p]Ward display has improved - it is now much clearer when an entity is Warded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with card damage and Ward display[/p][/*][*][p]Glow tooltip is now correct[/p][/*][*][p]Card dynamic numbers now display correctly when they come up as rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Some fun bits of visual polish here and there thanks to Andrew![/p][/*][*][p]Updated wording of Greed to make it clearer it has consequences[/p][/*][*][p]New curios all have their own art[/p][/*][*][p]Memory minion tooltip updated to be accurate[/p][/*][*][p]Various typos in random encounters and exorcism preludes[/p][/*][*][p]Sacrifice actions now have unique VFX[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]GAMEPLAY FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We think we've addressed all issues with abandoning a run and starting a new one - there should be no more getting stuck on loading screens, targeting issues, or cardplay issues[/p][/*][*][p]Solved multiple crash issues caused by circular dependencies[/p][/*][*][p]You should no longer encounter the same demon multiple times in a region, nor see the same random encounter more than once in a run[/p][/*][*][p]Hosts are now correct for Lesser Demon exorcisms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to many cards and curios[/p][/*][*][p]Silvered no longer does damage to you if you damage yourself[/p][/*][*][p]Ally abilities no longer occur after the exorcism is finished[/p][/*][*][p]Volatile now works correctly no matter how it was added to a card[/p][/*][*][p]Spark now works correctly as described in the tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Card duplication now works correctly - new cards are now actually playable, imagine that[/p][/*][*][p]Generic demons no longer spawn an invisible host who can be harmed[/p][/*][*][p]Noah's Expose line now occurs at the correct moment[/p][/*][*][p]Zhal Chort and Shame's minions now do their attack at the correct time, solving an issue where Shackle would not apply to them[/p][/*][*][p]Twilight Candle's effect now takes place after any auto-lighting of Candles, and takes them into account[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Demon intent system has been updated - damage and Ward numbers should now be accurate[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see which entities are the targets of demon abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Cinematic subtitles are now available in the Accessibility menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Demons have been rebalanced, and their attack damage now scales depending on where you encounter them in a region (or in the case of Lesser Demons, over the course of the game)[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer encounter a Greater demon as your second encounter in the first region, to make the difficulty ramp more reasonable[/p][/*][*][p]Book of Holy Flame now adds 2 glow rather than 1 when you have all Candles lit at end of turn[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to several demon's behaviours (notably Those Who Feast, Iaison the Devourer and Mammon)[/p][/*][*][p]Sacrifice damage is no longer modified by statuses like Wrath etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Dread, Disturbed, and Tremor are no longer modified by statuses like Wrath etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Small adjustments to demon behaviour (The Many As One, Wager Demon, Vishaak)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Current known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Storylet skip doesn't work consistently the same way, and the Continue button is too far away from the final line for comfort[/p][/*][*][p]Damage rounding being inconsistent is causing minor variances in some damage numbers[/p][/*][*][p]If you spam-click in shops, you can gain extra healing etc.[/p][/*][*][p]The new Devotional Candle card doesn't yet have its own art[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]This is our last update before launch![/h2][p]We're now going into finishing mode as we implement the final features of the game and continue to refine balance and run-progression leading up to launch. There's still a lot to do, with a lot of new content in v1, and we can't wait to show you what's in store![/p][p][/p][h2]What We Need From You[/h2][p]Please continue submitting feedback, and if you haven't already - please consider leaving a review! [/p][p]You can submit all your feedback on exorcisms (and the new content we've added, and bugs we've hopefully fixed) via bit (dot) ly / malysfeedback. If you run into a new bug, you can submit it at bit (dot) ly / malysbugreport[/p][p][b]We appreciate any and all feedback. [/b]ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][h2]Stay Up To Date[/h2][p]We'll have a new devlog coming up soon, and then announcements about launch -- so stay tuned![/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/summerfallstudios.com"]Stay in touch via Bluesky[/url] or [url="https://www.summerfallstudios.com/"]sign up to our mailing list.[/url] 
[/p][p]Speak soon, exorcists! [/p]

notes.title: v0.5 Beta now available!
notes.notes: [h1]Hellish morning, exorcists![/h1][p]Hello everyone! The past few weeks have been all about bugfixing, getting in as much other content as we can, and continuing to update and refresh the UI to make things clearer all around. [/p][p][/p][h2]What does the beta include?[/h2][list][*][p]Demon intent system has been updated - damage and Ward numbers should now be accurate for the entity the intent is on[/p][/*][*][p]Ward display has improved - it is now much clearer when an entity is Warded[/p][/*][*][p]You can now view Draw and Discard piles[/p][/*][*][p]Cinematic subtitles are now available in the Accessibility menu[/p][/*][*][p]Shop upgrades are live - spend Faith to gain permanent discounts in shops![/p][/*][*][p]More cards and curios[/p][/*][*][p]Two new allies that can appear as card rewards, one that can appear through a random encounter, and The Believer now has her own random encounter (and updated behaviour)[/p][/*][*][p]You should no longer encounter the same greater demon multiple times in a region, nor see the same random encounter more than once in a ru[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to many cards and curios[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to several demon's behaviours (notably Those Who Feast, Iaison the Devourer and Mammon)[/p][/*][*][p]Sacrifice damage is no longer modified by statuses like Wrath etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Dread, Disturbed, and Tremor are no longer modified by statuses like Wrath etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with card damage and Ward display[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with card display in deck overview and rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Silvered no longer does damage to you if you damage yourself[/p][/*][*][p]Volatile now works correctly no matter how it was added to a card[/p][/*][*][p]Glow tooltip is now correct[/p][/*][*][p]Spark now works correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues that could occur when loading a  new run[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Planned for next week’s release:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixing any remaining issues with card and demon number display - Ward display for demon intent doesn't include Toughen yet, the "Fight, Damn You!" card's numbers aren't quite right, and some intent icons are incorrect/need adjustment still. [/p][/*][*][p]Further bugfixes to whatever is reported - we want to keep making the game more stable and ensure it's working as expected![/p][/*][*][p]Further minor improvements to demon behaviours[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]How do I access a beta build?[/h2][p]To access the Malys beta build in between updates, there’ll be a few things you need to do.[/p][olist][*][p]Right click on Malys in Steam and select ‘Properties’[/p][/*][*][p]In the ‘Properties’ window, click on the ‘Betas’ tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the Beta Branch from the dropdown menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Close out and Steam should automatically start downloading the Malys Beta![/p][/*][/olist][p]It’s important that we know which build you’re on for testing purposes, so make sure you provide that information to us in your bug submissions and feedback submissions.You can always return to the main branch exactly the same way.[/p][p][/p][h2]Give us your feedback on the changes![/h2][p]How're you feeling about the UIUX changes? What about Shop upgrades and accessibility options? We'd love to hear![/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://form.typeform.com/to/FEdpxBVB"]Bug reports[/url] and [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/EFP3SOJg"]feedback submissions[/url] are GREATLY appreciated.[/h3][p][/p][p]Until next week, happy exorcising![/p][p]x[/p][p]Summerfall[/p]

notes.title: MALYS UPDATE - v0.4 NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[p]Hello exorcists! Welcome to 0.4 of Malys! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]v0.4 Beta feedback[/b][/h2][p]Feeback and bug reports from the beta have been SUPER useful - thank you to everyone who has taken the time to submit through our forms. We've handled the vast majority of reported bugs, [/p][p]We're glad Mammon has improved a little in Expel, but like with many demons, expect more updates to come. [/p][p]One important thing to note that has come up in feedback is that [b]there WILL be a mechanic to re-draw rewards[/b], which will with any luck make its way into the next update. We've received several notes about this, so we wanted to make sure it was called out.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.4 - New Content[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]CURIO UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Balance updates to a variety of curios[/p][/*][*][p]Reworks of several curios that weren't quite working[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of new curios that allow for some more interesting synergies[/p][/*][*][p]21 total curios now implemented and accessible out of a planned 30[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]CARD & MECHANIC UPDATES[/b][/h3][p]While we didn't get QUITE as many cards done as we wanted, we made some great progress.[/p][list][*][p]Updates to many cards, from cost to function[/p][/*][*][p]Quite a few ground-up redesigns[/p][/*][*][p]A chunk of new cards for a total of over 80 in-game of a planned 100*[/p][/*][*][p]A new status effect, Spark[/p][/*][*][p]There are now several ways to gain more than 3 Candles [/p][/*][/list][p]* There were a couple of features we weren't quite able to get to on the back-end that the rest of the cards relied on, so we opted to leave them for now and include them in next update in favor of getting the demon intent changes in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]DEMON UPDATES[/b][/h3][p]We’re slowly continuing to refine demons - several have had significant updates, but most important is a change you will never notice when playing, which is we’ve now moved all demons over to a new behaviour system - most of them still function almost identically right now, but this will  make future changes significantly easier and allow us to make them more interesting and reactive.
[/p][list][*][p]Shame now has a full behaviour set with working minions[/p][/*][*][p]Some major big fixes to several demons[/p][/*][*][p]Mammon is a little less punishing in Expel[/p][/*][*][p]Less curse card spam across the board[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SHOP UPGRADES[/b][/h3][p]You can now upgrade shops! Or, well, we've got the start of our shop upgrade system in there, which is focused on discounts. [/p][p]This is the first part of meta-progression in Malys: you can purchase shop upgrades that will give you permanent discounts. In the final game, there will be other mechanical benefits, as well as story benefits, to unlocking a shop all the way and having that character become a Patron.[/p][p]Big thanks to Alissa for taking on this feature and nailing it. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]ARTIFACTS FOR TESTING[/b][/h3][p]We've refreshed the Artifacts, with two new ones - one focused on Light and Glow, and another on Defense. These are concepts, and we haven't done extensive testing with them yet - so let us know what you think! Are they overpowered, underpowered? Do you have a favourite? Are they fun? We'd love to hear.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.4 - Demon intent and damage display[/b][/h2][p]We've reworked how damage displays as well as how demon intent displays, to give you a better sense of what is coming and to whom, thanks to our new targeting system.[/p][p]Card damage and Ward number display should now be accurate, inclusive of both owned statuses (such as Wrath or Shackle) as well as target statuses (like Vulnerable) where possible. To discover exactly what the final damage amount is on a target, select the card and hover over your target - the damage amount should update to include any statuses the target may have. [/p][p]We still have a bit more to go on this system - accurate demon damage/Ward numbers are still on their way, and the current plan is that we will be moving projected damage amounts to the demon intent target indicators so you can see exactly what will happen to each target. [/p][p]In the meantime, we hope these updates help to improve your experience![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.4 - Accessibility Options[/b][/h2][p]We've been hard at work to respond to your feedback about things like motion options and text size, and the fruits of that labor make their debut in this update. Huge props to Andrew who spearheaded these features and made them possible. [/p][h2][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/5f3bce415fddf37abcff9e3386b9f5ad3cc99167.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.4 - Bugfixes/General[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]UI/UX & TEXT FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Lesser Demon exorcisms are now less intense visually and aurally[/p][/*][*][p]Many tooltips have been updated for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects now expire correctly on all entities[/p][/*][*][p]Many minor updates to tooltip scaling, positioning and behaviour[/p][/*][*][p]Ward icons should now fade out correctly when Ward expires at the end of a turn[/p][/*][*][p]Minion spawn positions have been adjusted slightly so there should no longer be able to overlap information like status effect icons [/p][/*][*][p]Minion tooltips should no longer be able to appear behind other minions, or be cut off by the edge of screen[/p][/*][*][p]Elements in the candle area on the bottom-right of screen should now be positioned more consistently on 21:9 (Ultrawide) monitors[/p][/*][*][p]Longer card names are no longer obscured[/p][/*][*][p]Curios have now been scaled up in exorcisms and are larger on the screen[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]GAMEPLAY FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Baalzebuth's Verse will now correctly be added by Baalzebuth's Curse cards[/p][/*][*][p]Arm minions should behave correctly [/p][/*][*][p]Demons will no longer take actions that would reduce their Will to 0 and end the exorcism[/p][/*][*][p]Minions should no longer take an action after the demon has been defeated [/p][/*][*][p]The Arm and Puppet minions will correctly play VFX again when they perform an action [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a possible crash when fighting Iaison the Devourer (it shouldn't devour the game) [/p][/*][*][p]Puppet Fury no longer continues to work after the exorcism it is used in[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicated cards should now properly include changes and Upgrade status[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The demon intent tooltip now provides specific information about what the demon will do, and to whom, on it's next turn. Noah still cannot divine what an unexposed demon will do, but will have more information in Endure and Expel[/p][/*][*][p]An indicator has been added that will appear over Noah or Allies when they are the target (or a potential target) of an attack or debuff in the next demon action [/p][/*][*][p]The way damage and Ward numbers are shown in the demon intent area of the UI has been reworked to be clearer and more easily readable [/p][/*][*][p]Timing has been updated to play out faster for several Minion actions. In particular, when a demon summons multiple minions in a turn, this should take around half the time as it did previously. Less waiting around![/p][/*][*][p]Status effects and curios now have activation VFX where relevant[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility option: Disable Exorcism Motion. This setting allows the user to turn off repeating/looping movement seen during exorcisms, such as the moving smoke during the Expose phase, the panning sky in the background during Endure and Expel, and several others. Some users have reported these types of continuous motion can cause eye strain or potentially motion sickness [/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility option: Large Storylet Text. Increases the text size in storylets, useful for users who find the default text size difficult to read[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility option: Large Tooltips. This option increases the size of the tooltip boxes and their text on all tooltips in the game! [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Shame demon now summons two minions when it is revealed, and has more intelligent behaviour[/p][/*][*][p]Card reward numbers have significantly rebalanced - Lesser Demons give you 1 of 2 cards, Greater Demons give you 1 of 3 cards, Region Bosses give you 2 of 4 cards[/p][/*][*][p]Assorted cards and status effects have been updated to apply to all candles, to support when Noah has more than 3 [/p][/*][*][p]Doubt now only affects damage[/p][/*][*][p]Pocket has changed to only occur on discard, moving the card it is on to the top of the draw pile[/p][/*][*][p]Dysthymia will use more intelligent behaviour, like not using an ability that would defeat itself[/p][/*][*][p]Various demons' behaviour has been tweaked and updated for better fight experiences [/p][/*][*][p]Updates to and redesigns of many cards and curios[/p][/*][*][p]Haunting Song has been renamed Haunting Chorus[/p][/*][*][p]Light the Candles has been renamed to Illumination to prevent confusion about its behaviour (it does not, in fact, light the candles)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Current known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It's likely demon intent isn't 100% correct yet - let us know where there are weirdnesses![/p][/*][*][p]Some of the new curios don't have their own art yet, as well as some of the new cards[/p][/*][*][p]The Center Must Hold card is broken and its effects are persistent[/p][/*][*][p]If you abandon a run inside an exorcism mid-run (rather than waiting to finish the exorcism), return to the main menu and start a new run, occasionally the loading screen will remain forever - just restart the game if this occurs and it will work fine[/p][/*][*][p]Some cards have the wrong art in Gideon's shop[/p][/*][*][p]Storylet skip doesn't work consistently the same way, and the Continue button is too far away from the final line for comfort[/p][/*][*][p]Damage rounding being inconsistent is causing minor variances in some damage numbers[/p][/*][*][p]If you spam-click in shops, you can gain extra healing etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]THE PATHWAY TO v1[/h2][p]We said during Malys' Kickstarter campaign that we intended to hit v1 before the end of the year, and we are on track for that. [/p][p]More on that in our update next week, but the long and the short of it is we are planning one more big update after this before v1. V1 will itself will come with a lot of new content - region 3, more demons, lots of story content, end-game, post-end-game and more. [/p][p]Hitting v1 just means we've done the base of our planned content -- we'll continue to support and update the game afterwards! The scope of those updates will depend on how the game does at v1 launch, but we're pretty committed to this project (as you might have noticed by making sure we found a way to reach this point even without a successful Kickstarter), so no matter what you'll continue to see updates from our side, though they will be slower. [/p][p][/p][h2]What We Need From You[/h2][p]Please continue submitting feedback, and if you haven't already - please consider leaving a review! [/p][p]You can submit all your feedback on exorcisms (and the new content we've added, and bugs we've hopefully fixed) via bit (dot) ly / malysfeedback. If you run into a new bug, you can submit it at bit (dot) ly / malysbugreport[/p][p][b]This week, we'd love to hear feedback on builds and progression changes.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Stay Up To Date[/h2][p]We’ll be in touch next week with a new devlog to talk about the pathway to v1 and what that looks like, as well as responding to feedback on the v0.4 update and a little about what v0.5, our last big update before we hit v1 will look lke.[/p][p]We'll also be posting on our socials when the devlog goes live, so [url="https://bsky.app/profile/summerfallstudios.com"]stay in touch via Bluesky[/url] or [url="https://www.summerfallstudios.com/"]sign up to our mailing list.[/url] 
[/p][p]Speak soon, exorcists! [/p]

notes.title: v0.4 Beta now available!
notes.notes: [h1]Hellish morning, exorcists![/h1][p]We’ve been hard at work going through all your feedback, updating and making new cards and curios (which is mostly a lot of new backend engineering work), adjusting power progression and balance, and many other things. We've also managed to slip some accessibility updates in.[/p][p]As a reminder, being a beta build, it's going to be less stable than the live build branch. This means it's more prone to breaking and strange errors, but if you’re willing to experiment to help us out in making sure the fixes we’re putting in are working, we really appreciate it![/p][p][/p][h2]What does the beta include?[/h2][list][*][p]Demon intent display updates! It should now be clearer what the demon is doing and to whom, through target indicators[/p][/*][*][p]A variety of updated and reworked cards as well as some new cards (new cards do not yet have their proper art yet)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and reworked curios as well as some new curios (new curios do not yet have their proper art yet) [/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility options: Turn off background motion in exorcisms, large text for tooltips, large text for storylets[/p][/*][*][p]Card reward numbers have significantly rebalanced - Lesser Demons give you 1 of 2 cards, Greater Demons give you 1 of 3 cards, Region Bosses give you 2 of 4 cards[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and slightly more intelligent behaviour for some demons, and Shame’s minions now work correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to speed of various UI animations (let us know anywhere things are still particularly slow, especially with repeat actions eg. minions etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Doubt now only affects Damage-dealing cards and effects[/p][/*][*][p]Pocket has changed to only occur on discard, moving the card it is on to the top of the draw pile[/p][/*][*][p]Haunting Song has been renamed to Haunting Chorus (Dave liked it better)[/p][/*][*][p]Light the Candles has been renamed to Illumination to prevent confusion about its behaviour (it does not, in fact, light the candles)[/p][/*][*][p]There should no longer be any issues quitting mid-exorcism, continuing or starting a new run, and entering another exorcism[/p][/*][*][p]Various other bug-fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Not included, but planned for next week’s release:[/h2][list][*][p]Specific damage display for cards and demon intent - this one is still cooking, due to lots of backend work required -- there's a chance this one may have to get pushed out, depending on how things go, but we'll let you know in our release update next week[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes for demon intent display (we know there are issues, any you report are very helpful)[/p][/*][*][p]As many of the rest of the planned curios and cards as we're able to get through![/p][/*][*][p]Several ways to add additional Candles (up to 5), as well as a new status called Spark, which lights a Candle at the start of your turn per stack, and removes a stack.[/p][/*][*][p]The basics for shop upgrades, our first meta-progression element - at the cost of Faith, you'll be able to gain progressive permanent discounts at each shop. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Update on Light [/h2][p]Thank you all for your thoughts and feedback on Light last week! We're so glad that it’s working as intended. We’ll leave it as it is, if the current balance feels about right [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1fae1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]How do I access a beta build?[/h2][p]To access the Malys beta build in between updates, there’ll be a few things you need to do.[/p][olist][*][p]Right click on Malys in Steam and select ‘Properties’[/p][/*][*][p]In the ‘Properties’ window, click on the ‘Betas’ tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the Beta Branch from the dropdown menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Close out and Steam should automatically start downloading the Malys Beta![/p][/*][/olist][p]It’s important that we know which build you’re on for testing purposes, so make sure you provide that information to us in your bug submissions and feedback submissions.You can always return to the main branch exactly the same way.[/p][p][/p][h2]Give us your feedback on the changes![/h2][p]Some of these are big, substantive changes that fundamentally change difficulty and power progression, as well as many new options and mechanical combinations. These are always difficult to gauge, and so we are relying on you to tell us what feels like it's working, and what totally sucks. [/p][p][/p][h3] [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/FEdpxBVB"]Bug reports[/url] and [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/EFP3SOJg"]feedback submissions[/url] are GREATLY appreciated.[/h3][p][/p][p]Until next week, happy exorcising![/p][p]x[/p][p]Summerfall[/p]

notes.title: Delaying v0.4 a week!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Thought I’d jump in with a quick update, since normally we’d want to be putting out a beta today. v0.4 is taking a little longer than expected, for a couple reasons I’ll get into, so we’ve decided to push this update back a week to make sure we can get everything in.[/p][p]You can expect the beta at the end of next week, and then v0.4 release in 2 weeks.[/p][p][/p][h1]So why the delay?[/h1][p]Firstly, the changes we’re making and content we’re adding is not insignificant. Some of it has been more difficult than anticipated, either because the changes have been hard to integrate into existing systems or because they are big and significant changes that we really need to think about.[/p][p]Over the past few weeks we've also had to juggle some people being off the project for a little while, which has resulted in things generally taking longer than we'd hoped. [/p][p]All in all, rather than trying to cut the scope of the update (and therefore the final game), or do a ton of overtime, we've decided to push things back just slightly. [/p][p][/p][h1]v0.4 will be the chunkiest update yet[/h1][p]The upside is that we've had a little more time to plan and design, so this update will be even chunkier than it was before when it does finally hit in September.[/p][p]There's a couple of things we're keeping tight to our chests for now and will likely talk about next week when the beta goes up, but to tide you over, here are a few sneak previews. [/p][p][/p][h1]Demon Intent & Damage Display updates[/h1][p]As mentioned in Devlog 4, we're making updates to Demon Intent and Damage Display. [/p][p]Damage display across the game, whether it be on cards or demon intent, will be accurate to what will actually happen wherever possible. This means it will calculate Wrath, Shackle, Vulnerable, and anything else that affects the final number. [/p][p]Demon Intent will be a little more specific, showing targets (both actual and potential), and with extra information on the tooltip. At immediate glance you'll see information about the demon's Primary Intent, but you can also mouseover its intent for a more detailed breakdown and any information about secondary actions. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/f398c396df2cc7c3b44d1e73534d1c770abdc2d9.png"][/img][i]Gain additional information about a demon's upcoming action through updated tooltips[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/3b0d12a8b9209c2cd67ab60d916c7d5715cbd601.png"][/img][i]Targets and potential targets of the main action the demon will take are now much easier to see[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Card Changes[/h1][p]Arguably the biggest part of this update will be to cards and card play! [/p][list][*][p]Around 20 new cards at minimum, which should put the card total above 100[/p][/*][*][p]Card Rebalancing - updates to cost and/or value on a variety of cards[/p][/*][*][p]Significant reworks - we're changing a significant amount of cards (just under 20) that were a little too basic or boring, to create more opportunities for synergy and a bigger variety of playstyles. Some we've thrown out entirely and have redesigned from scratch, and some just have significant changes to make them more interesting.[/p][/*][*][p]Broadly, cards outside the starting set are going to be a little more powerful. 
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Curios[/h1][p]Another big update will be to Curios. In Malys, Curios are intended to help facilitate build strategies and synergy, but the current Curios have been pretty limited and general. [/p][list][*][p]We'll be more than doubling the available Curios, with many new ones and some big reworks of several existing Curios[/p][/*][*][p]Curios should generally be a little more balanced[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll be getting more curios during play, thanks to...
[/p][/*][/list][h1]Exorcism reward updates[/h1][p]Now that we’re getting a stronger idea of balance, part of the issue is you can get too many cards too quickly, and many cards are not interesting enough to take. [/p][p]In this coming update, we’ll be testing lowering card reward amounts as well as the many card changes mentioned above to help address both issues. In a near future update, this will be paired with a mechanic which will allow you a limited amount of reward reshuffles per run that will increase as you progress, allowing you to hone in a little more on specific builds.[/p][p]Individual cards, upgrades and curios are intended to be more impactful and powerful than games like Slay the Spire, which definitely makes some of this balancing more difficult![/p][p]In a future update we'll also be adding Curios into exorcism rewards - while we're still working out the details, it's likely that each Greater Demon will have a % chance of dropping a curio, and region bosses will guarantee you a curio.[/p][p]These changes, paired with all of the card and Curio changes, should result in a significant change to the run experience - so we’ll be relying on your feedback to help guide balance and fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/908ff1c411e336f446ed416012df8e888d3ae0a1.png"][/img][i]Sneak preview of one of our new cards, Fight, Damn You![/i] [/p][h1]Mammon[/h1][p]Finally, we hear you - we have more work to do on our favourite greedy Region Boss! Expel in particular continues to feel bad (and is frankly just boring), so we are thinking about how we can punch this exorcism up without losing the Greed attack and the gamble for Faith.[/p][p]We're still working this one out, so if anyone has any thoughts, let us know![/p][h1]
Final questions for you [/h1][p]To finish this update I have one question for you:[/p][p]Do you ever use Light for damage, or almost exclusively to heal? Light has been an issue for balance, and we’ve broadly heard reports that it’s a little confusing. We’re considering changing it to solely heal, and renaming Glow (which would still heal and do damage depending on target). We’d love to hear your thoughts![/p][p][/p][p]x[/p][p]Liam and Summerfall[/p]

notes.title: MALYS UPDATE - v0.3 NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! Welcome to 0.3 of Malys! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Story So Far[/b][/h2][p]As of last week, we released the beta for players. You can [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3449690?emclan=103582791475115239&emgid=525350155171397635"]read about it here[/url], but ultimately we wanted to make sure we gave the most dedicated of you an option to try the changes we're proposing ahead of time. This has already been super useful - shoutout to the 10% of you that are playing and engaging with it, and thank you to those submitting feedback and bug reports![/p][p]We've been able to fix a number of issues thanks to your reports, and have made some adjustments based on your suggestions as well.[/p][p]On to the exciting stuff![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.3 - New Content[/b][/h2][p]We've added a new region for you to try: The Strip. Yes, there are now [i]two[/i] regions in game for you to play through. What this means is a bunch of changes to regions in general - read on![/p][p]As we mentioned in our devlog the other week, this has involved a significant rebuild of region generation and the rules involved to support multiple shorter regions as intended, rather than the single longer region you've been used to. This region change also comes with new demons, and a new region boss. [/p][list][*][p]With the addition of region 2, we've shortened the length of region 1 through this rebuild of region generation. This means the regions better match what an in-game region will play like length wise in the full release.[/p][/*][*][p]Cozzie livs (that's Australian for cost-of-living) is high, and it's the same in the city of Malys. We've made adjustments so you won't encounter shops in a run before you have a chance to accumulate some Faith to spend. [/p][/*][*][p]We've adjusted the width of each region to be 5 nodes instead of 4 - meaning more options for your decision making![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]REGION 2: THE STRIP[/b][/h3][p]Region 2: The Strip is here, with new music from the excellent Belinda Coomes![/p][list][*][p]Included in The Strip are three new demons (Levekh of the Cold, Iaison the Devourer, and Zhal Chort) with their own unique challenges, plus a new Boss at the end of the region (Baalzebuth)[/p][/*][*][p]When they are burned, Cards now gain the Ashed status for the rest of the turn, which prevents them from being burned again (Thanks Eric F. for the inspiration!)[/p][/*][*][p]Mammon now has a unique exorcism prelude![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.3 - Mammon[/b][/h2][p]A number of you have been giving us feedback on the Mammon fight. At the moment for a lot of you, it's feeling not only difficult to defeat Mammon but at times, really drawn out. [/p][p]We quickly realised that we'd made a bit of a math error. Whoops. Mammon has been strolling along with 1 stack of Fortify too many, making him incredibly difficult to defeat. We've fixed this for this update, as well as lowered the amount of Restrict he applies slightly. We'd love to know if the fight feels better, or if you're still feeling that drag. [/p][p]We've also updated a few other exorcisms such as Pearl Eye based on your feedback, and fixed various incorrect or broken abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/fe0ef0594f8f9e12bdeaf4fe4c97f4118ecd00df.jpg"][/img][i]Hopefully Mammon will be a little less painful here on out![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.3 - Player Visual Feedback[/b][/h2][p]The other piece of feedback we generally tend to see the most is on player feedback in game. There's a [i]lot[/i] going on in the systems of Malys, so making sure it's all clear to players as it happens is an ongoing process that we'll be continuing to iterate on. [/p][p]We've made a bunch of updates, including:[/p][list][*][p]Updating card mouseover/selection visual feedback for consistency and to be more intuitive. Selecting rewards should now be a little clearer![/p][/*][*][p]Updated and added a bunch of VFX across a number of cards and actions. This includes things like adding visual feedback when a card gains or loses a keyword during an exorcism, as well as VFX when you gain and lose Faith. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.3 - Bugfixes/General[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]UI/UX & TEXT FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Cards gaining Volatile or Unburnable (as well as the new Sealed keyword) while in your hand now update their visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Using Light on Allies now displays correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips on Allies are now easier to get and no longer obscure their statuses[/p][/*][*][p]Minion and Ally death animations now play properly[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor UI fixes, updates and polish[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]GAMEPLAY FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Mammon's exorcism should now be less mind-numbingly grindy[/p][/*][*][p]When you finish your battle with Mammon, you now gain your Greed reward[/p][/*][*][p]You should now only be able to encounter each Greater Demon once per run[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous fixes for demon abilities[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Card Selection has been updated to be clearer[/p][/*][*][p]Map legend should now be a little clearer - we heard a lot of feedback on this one![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Region 1 (The Stacks) has been shortened to match final length[/p][/*][*][p]In Region 1, shops now only appear after the third vertical node[/p][/*][*][p]Regions are now 5 nodes across, to create some more run option breadth[/p][/*][*][p]If you are given cards during the Demon's turn, you can no longer draw over your hand draw max (usually 6)[/p][/*][*][p]Lesser demons have been buffed in difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Lesser Demon Will now scales as you progress through the game[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Demon Will now scales as you progress through a region[/p][/*][*][p]Doomed Curse card cost has been reduced to 1[/p][/*][*][p]Salt cards are now Unburnable, preventing them from becoming an infinite resource with a card draw build[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/967151f5563d75a76b8da65ea219f461c08e05bd.jpg"][/img][i]One of our new demons, the mysterious puppeteer, Zhal Chort.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Current known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]NEW (8/8/2025) [/b]- Baalzebuth's Verse status is not added by Baalzabuth's Curse cards (and thus they are missing the relevant tooltip)[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW (7/8/2025) - [/b]Statuses on demons don't always disappear when they should, causing it to seem like they have multiple of the same status[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW (7/8/2025) - [/b]Shame's Arm minions don't currently work as intended, and just sit there looking oddly protective[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW (7/8/2025) - [/b]Regression: Every now and then on the map, one of the nodes' connecting lines is invisible - it's still there, but you won't see it til you come out of its event[/p][/*][*][p]If you abandon a run and then start a new one without quitting entirely, a myriad of potential issues can ensue such as doubling cards, demons becoming un-targetable, infinite loading screens, and more. The easiest fix for now is to quit out and restart![/p][/*][*][p]Multiple minions doing actions (particularly the Feed minions) feel very slow[/p][/*][*][p]The Center Must Hold card is broken and its effects are persistent[/p][/*][*][p]Some cards have the wrong art in Gideon's shop[/p][/*][*][p]Pocket needs reworking as it is currently somewhat broken[/p][/*][*][p]Storylet skip doesn't work consistently the same way, and the Continue button is too far away from the final line for comfort[/p][/*][*][p]Damage rounding being inconsistent is causing minor variances in some damage numbers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Things We're Working On[/h2][p]As we mentioned in the previous devlog, we've been working a lot on systems for further balancing to set ourselves up well in iterating on the difficulty curve of Malys. Your feedback is crucial to know when we're drifting to either too hard or too easy, but this work of building models to understand and adjust at scale is going to take more time. System-wide rebalances interact with a [i]lot[/i], so we appreciate your patience as we do it piece by piece. Your feedback on exorcisms has been critical for this, as it helps us to understand where the fights are excelling and where they're falling a little flat.[/p][p][/p][p]The in-game codex we mentioned is still in progress, and the digital online version isn't ready just yet either. Our focus on regions overtook it this week, but it's still in the works - we promise. [/p][p][/p][p]We've started work on a refresh of Demon Intent display, which is coming along well, and are also starting to design new mechanics and a further raft of new content for v0.4 and beyond. [/p][p][/p][h2]What We Need From You[/h2][p]Please continue submitting feedback, and if you haven't already - please consider leaving a review! [/p][p]You can submit all your feedback on exorcisms (and the new content we've added, and bugs we've hopefully fixed) via bit (dot) ly / malysfeedback. If you run into a new bug, you can submit it at bit (dot) ly / malysbugreport[/p][p][b]What we'd love to hear about this week is specifically around the regions - how does the adjustment in length feel, what would you change, what do you like about them?[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Stay Up To Date[/h2][p]We’ll be in touch next week with a new devlog to talk about what we’re hearing and what we’ll be focusing on for the following update. [/p][p]We'll also be posting on our socials when the devlog goes live, so [url="https://bsky.app/profile/summerfallstudios.com"]stay in touch via Bluesky[/url] or [url="https://www.summerfallstudios.com/"]sign up to our mailing list.[/url] 
[/p][p]Speak soon, exorcists! [/p]

So, to enable you all to get stuck in a little earlier, we're setting up a [b]beta testing program[/b] as we mentioned in [url="https://www.summerfallstudios.com/malys-developer-updates/devlog-3-exorcisms"]our previous devlog here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][h2]Quick changelog for the v0.3 BETA:[/h2][list][*][p]Region switching has been implemented, and region 2 has been added! Right now there are two demons it will cycle through in addition to generics (which - for now - are the same difficulty as region 1). The rest will be added in v0.3 proper.[/p][/*][*][p]The Region 2 Boss has been added[/p][/*][*][p]Mammon's Greed reward has now been implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Player now heals on entering region 2[/p][/*][*][p]New exorcism preludes have been added for both Mammon and the new region 2 boss[/p][/*][*][p]General UI updates and polish[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]How will the beta work?[/h2][p]We'll have it live about a week prior to any planned update. This means it's more prone to breaking and strange errors, but if you’re willing to experiment to help us out in making sure the fixes we’re putting in are working, we really appreciate it![/p][p][/p][h2]How do I access a beta build?[/h2][p]To access the Malys beta build in between updates, there’ll be a few things you need to do.[/p][olist][*][p]Right click on Malys in Steam and select ‘[b]Properties[/b]’[/p][/*][*][p]In the ‘[b]Properties[/b]’ window, click on the ‘[b]Betas[/b]’ tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the [b]Beta Branch[/b] from the dropdown menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Close out and Steam should automatically start downloading the [b]Malys Beta[/b]![/p][/*][/olist][p]It’s important that we know which build you’re on for testing purposes, so make sure you provide that information to us in your [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/FEdpxBVB"]bug submissions[/url] and [url="https://form.typeform.com/to/EFP3SOJg"]feedback submissions[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]You can always return to the main branch exactly the same way. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ll post on socials anytime a new Beta goes live, so keep an eye out! [/p][p]Thanks for your continued support of Malys,[/p][p][/p][p]Liam [/p]

notes.title: MALYS UPDATE - v0.2 NOW LIVE
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! Welcome to our FIRST update for Malys in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]In case you missed it, we [url="https://www.summerfallstudios.com/malys-developer-updates/devlog-two-malys-reception"]wrote a devlog after the release[/url] talking through all the feedback we'd received and what we'd be focusing on for this update. Going through it agauin now, we got through even more than we thought we might.[/p][p]We've been reading all your posts, reviews, comments, and submissions, and using them to work out our major focus areas as we go forward. This patch, we've tried to resolve a whole bunch of important fixes as reported by you! [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Our First Early Access Update![/b][/h2][p]We've been hard at work since launch doing our best to make the play experience as smooth as possible, iron out as many issues as we can, and start to plan The Future Of Malys. It's been a lot of fun. Normally when we work on projects, the things you make don't get player feedback until the game comes out - so the gap between making something and releasing it into the world is measured in years. With Early Access, we get to measure that gap in weeks, and that's genuinely exciting for us![/p][p]The focus of this initial update has been on improving the play experience and solving issues, but we've also started to work on new content for you to check out.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.2 - New Content[/b][/h2][p]Firstly, we've added three new demons - one more Lesser Demon, and two Greater Demons (previews from Region 2). Both Greater Demons hit harder than the Region 1 demons, and we have put them in the second half of the current run as a result.[/p][p]We know many of you have been trying different builds and approaches, so we're eager to hear your feedback on how your strategies need adjusting or shifting with these new demons! We don't want to spoil them, so here's your treat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/7c067f6066102cef75a216da624e15739111b47b.png"][/img][i]Who's that horrifying disfigured broken demon? It's... you'll see![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We've also added a number of new allies, who have different supporting abilities or interactions depending on where you encounter them. Some of these new allies are gained through new random encounters, others are in the general card reward pool![/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW DEMONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Lesser Demon: The Lesser[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Demon ([i]Region 2 preview[/i]): Vishaak[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Demon ([i]Region 2 preview[/i]): Wager Demon[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW ALLIES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Investigator (+ new random scene to gain his aid)[/p][/*][*][p]The Believer[/p][/*][*][p]The Guardian[/p][/*][*][p]The Backup  (+ new random scene to gain his aid)[/p][/*][*][p]The Spectre[/p][/*][*][p]The Occultist  (+ new random scene to gain his aid)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593831/bc38ae83c11423717a70f30830f551bb7b3cc46c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW CARDS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A Cry For Help[/p][/*][*][p]Aid From Beyond[/p][/*][*][p]Tie Them Down![/p][/*][*][p]Gratitude[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]OTHER CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All Greater Demons, as well as Mammon, are now more difficult! We expect to completely overhaul difficulty as part of a big balance review in the future, but for now, we hope this helps make things a little more interesting.[/p][/*][*][p]The Doubt status has been redesigned. Previously, Doubt gave a 70% chance of redirecting targeted actions to a random target. The new design gives a 30% chance that any targeted action will miss and have no effect. We would love feedback on how this feels![/p][/*][*][p]The Wisp now does its effects at the beginning of the player's turn[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Nun ally with a focus on Light and Glow, rather than damage dealing[/p][/*][*][p]Expose has an additional more damaging attack added in, and demon Countdown actions have been buffed to make them more significant [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Faith reward for Lesser Demons to 15, and Greater Demons to 35 to see how this feels in terms of purchasing from shops in game. \[[b]Note: These numbers will be entirely reworked in a future update, along with the entire economy, so this is just for now![/b]] [/p][/*][*][p]Some of you reported the 'Skip Storylet' button appears before the storylet itself. This is intentional, so players can quickly skip through narrative if that's their preference without having to wait for the text to load first. We made some improvements to how it displays to make this a little clearer. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Early Access Update v0.2 - Bugfixes[/b][/h2][p] Many players who played for a while [b]reported a slowdown to gameplay[/b], where actions would take way longer than expected to trigger. notes.title: Ex Dragon Age writer's new deckbuilder Malys is the next step to his dream RPG
notes.notes:
David Gaider wants to make a new RPG and, with credits that include the original Baldur's Gate games, Dragon Age: Origins through Inquisition, and Star Wars: The Old Republic, it's no secret as to why. Gaider's writing has launched franchises, paved the way for the romance systems we see in games like Baldur's Gate 3 and, in many ways, changed the way that we approach narrative-focused videogames. But before we get another big RPG, there's Malys, an "unholy roguelike deckbuilder" that oozes high gothic elegance. Cast as Noah, a former priest turned exorcist, your job is to hunt down the titular demon and bring about its end in the most bloody way possible. It's a marked shift in tone from Summerfall Studios' first game, Stray Gods, but it doesn't skimp on style.

After the success of the mighty Balatro, roguelike deckbuilders aren't slowing down in 2025, courtesy of Slay the Spire 2 and Monster Train 2, both of which are on their way. But there's more. Mixing the visual flair of Metaphor Refantazio, with writing and worldbuilding from original Dragon Age creator David Gaider, Malys is a stunning challenger that puts you in the shoes of Noah, a priest turned exorcist and demon hunter. Built by Summerfall Studios, it's just landed on Kickstarter, and it's already making a splash.
